modals_jsx.out_of_bandwidth_reason_2: To keep things free, MELEK intelligently allocates Resource Credits to each user based on their MELEK Power holdings, which can be used to submit a limited number of feeless transactions. This system prioritizes actions by good community members while limiting spam.
